requiredCases: Team guards: application User INSERT does not add a reference to a closed team, even bypassing the Core API
Team guards: final state blocks same-tx insert→deactivate and accepts add then remove before closing
Team guards: an inactive Queue and a Skill are still current references; moving out/removing is allowed before closing
Team guards: future delegation still blocks, but expired/revoked delegation does not block
Team guards: Journey uses the pinned version; terminal/history does not block and unresolved legacy blocks only closing
Team guards: CG and outbound distinguish a true terminal from expiry/lease; reopening requires an active team
Team guards: User writer-first/deactivate-first race with real transactions and try-lock does not wait
Team guards: legacy owner intent without a canonical binding blocks closing any team in the tenant, but rename/cleanup still work
Team guards: validated owner payload identifies source/target without guessing the head and ACK still blocks until the continuation is durable
Team guards: a schedule in CLAIMED needs a durable enrollment before it stops blocking the pinned owner
Team guards: scoped refilter/future work and pending segment intent block; unscoped/terminal entry does not block
Team guards: a SEND still HELD blocks even when the enrollment is terminal and the reservation is released; a terminal SEND is history
Team guards: resolve the canonical owner receipt before treating it as legacy unknown; an unknown version does not borrow the proof of the original command
Team guards: a legacy reference does not allow reactivating a User/Queue or extending a grant on a closed team; cleanup still works
Team guards: EXPLAIN ANALYZE closure on 60,000 references stays within the 2s budget and excludes other tenants
Team guards: app does not borrow the PROVISIONING lifecycle to bypass the provisioner Core effect receipt
Team: an Admin creates via HTTP and reads back the same UUID and revision 1 without enabling a Voice policy
Team: rename with CAS and replay of the original, no revision increase on a no-op, and an old revision is rejected
Team: the UUID keyset list has a signed cursor bound to tenant/live scope and a Supervisor sees their own team
Team DB: a no-op DML after a Core command does not increase the revision and does not force an old receipt again
Team DB: the app cannot delete a UUID, edit revision metadata or rename without an effect receipt
Team: deactivate an empty team with CAS, keep receipt/audit, then replay/no-op works; a deactivated team can still be renamed
Team: cannot deactivate a team that has Users including inactive ones, keeps the original rejection, and sends only the kind and count
Team: unknown legacy suppresses only deactivation; create/rename work and an inactive no-op does not recheck the closure
Team: validation uses UTF-16/trim/control characters, and the name is unique including inactive, case-sensitive
Team: every endpoint uses live proof/role and does not reveal data of a resource in another tenant or another Supervisor team
Team: a busy reference fence keeps the admission, has no effect, and retrying the original command succeeds after the lock is released
Team: read/list return a validated X-Request-Id and do not cache results that depend on user permission
Team: rename still works while the reference fence is held, without waiting for the tenant to be idle
Team/People: an actual B2 pending operation/lifecycle keeps the Team creation even when a User moves out; a terminal no-effect leaves history
